I have farmed this land for many years, and the sandy soil here in Lindi gets tired quickly if I do not give it something back. I managed to get some fertilizer through the voucher program this season, and I also have manure from our goats and chickens to mix into the soil. Weeding must be done by hand with a hoe because I cannot afford chemicals for maize, and there is no water for irrigation so we pray for the vuli and masika rains. The plot is too big for my family alone, so I will hire some young people from the village when it is time to plant and weed.
